concerns.text: T026 explicitly implements 'Standard Logistic Regression (NOT GLMM)' and defers GLMM to future work. This directly violates the Plan (plan.md) which mandates 'Mixed-Effects Logistic Regression (GLMM)' to handle nested data structures and avoid Type I error inflation. The task silently relaxes the approved technical approach.

T029 implements only the Benjamini-Hochberg method for multiple-comparison correction. FR-006 requires applying 'Bonferroni or Benjamini-Hochberg'. By omitting the Bonferroni option/fallback, the task fails to satisfy the full scope of the functional requirement, leaving the implementation partial.

T041 enforces a 'hard stop after 500 total examples' for streaming. FR-001 mandates a limit of '500 examples per task' (implying 500 GSM8K + 500 MiniGrid = 1000 total). T041's global cap of 500 violates the dataset size requirement defined in the spec.

T021 specifies processing 'fixed-size token batches of 50 tokens'. FR-007 mandates processing 'in batches of 50 tokens'. However, T041 (Phase 7) references 'chunks of 500 rows'. The tasks lack a unified definition of the batch unit (tokens vs rows) required to satisfy the strict 7GB RAM limit in FR-007, creating a semantic gap in the memory constraint implementation.

T031 requires writing 'FDR metric' to the final report. SC-004 requires measuring 'decay of predictive power (AUC-ROC) across sequence lengths (short vs. long)'. No task explicitly describes generating, splitting, or analyzing 'short' vs 'long' sequence subsets to satisfy SC-004. This acceptance criterion is dropped from the task list.
